ShortDescription.Value: Reduce taxi traffic and Cim use in the city.

Publish.LongDescription:
### Taxi Traffic [BETA] Citizens make smarter travel choices by reducing taxi use.
### What it does - ✅ **Residents avoid taxis**, you choose how strongly local households avoid taxis: 0% = vanilla behavior | 100% = maximum avoidance. - ✅ Optional **Commuters avoid taxis** and **Tourists avoid taxis** [x] toggles let you reduce taxi use for those groups too.
### What to expect - Fewer taxi trips after a short adjustment period. - Existing taxis may still be visible briefly while active trips and normal taxi-stand standby behavior finish naturally. - In testing, at maximum taxi avoidance settings, it also had the side benefit of stopping outside-connection (OC) taxis from flooding highways; there was little/no taxi demand to serve. - Use **Game Defaults** to restore vanilla taxi choices (everything off and Resident sliders at 0%).
### Safety / compatibility - Safe to remove anytime. - No Harmony based patching; less likely to break on game patch day. - Tip: If you want to verify usage, check Options menu > mod Status, see if usage is going down after a city runs a little.
### Support and Feedback - Easiest way to support is click the LIKE 👍 button (top right). - For Feedback click on the Github or Discord icon links (right side of page). PR's are welcome.
### Credits and Thanks - RiverMochi: mod author - Noel/Noel2 (of MapExt): testing, feedback - Thumbnail: Wikipedia Traffic Congestion, photo by joiseyshowaa from Freehold, NJ - World Class Traffic Jam 2, license CC BY-SA 2.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/index.php?curid=63542844
### How it works - Applies the game's own vanilla taxi flags which is easier + safer. Research showed using "heavy hammer" methods to disable the complex taxi system creates scary frozen citizen zombies (before you ask, no we don't want that). - Some taxis may still remain in the city. Taxi Traffic allows active trips and normal taxi-stand standby behavior to finish naturally for game stability. - If you don't want normal standby taxis at taxi stands, then delete the stands. - Note: if you have no local taxi depots, the game uses outside connection (OC) sources to bring taxis to fill local requests. If you keep the Taxi slider at less than 100% avoidance, the OC taxis come in to fill any void. Outside connections can supply taxis when city taxi demand is not being satisfied by local supply. Recommended: have some local taxis if the slider and toggles are at anything but full ON [x] and 100%.
